measurements_27.required_input: n=16 closed H/L/C

measurements_27.required_input: n+1 closed closes

measurements_27.definition: TR/ATRprev; abs(C-O)/max(H-L,tick); (C-L)/max(range,tick); signed progress
measurements_27.test_oracle: Wick negative, positive displacement, zero ATR

measurements_27.required_input: l/r in 2,3,4; contiguous bars

measurements_27.test_oracle: Tied pivots and known-at prefix tests

measurements_27.required_input: confirmed swings/predeclared range/old zone
